summary: FortuneX Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO of 8,625,000 units (including full exercise of over-allotment) at $10.00 per unit, grossing $86.25 million. Each unit comprises one ordinary share and one-half of a warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. Polaris Advisory Partners served as sole book-running manager. The filing also notes entry into underwriting and warrant agreements. As a SPAC, the registrant will seek a business combination within a set period. Watch for future target announcements and shareholder votes on any proposed acquisition.
